name: gym-routine-app
description: Monorepo root: orchestration scripts for /client and /server

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix server && npx --prefix client tsc -b client
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix server && npm run lint --prefix client
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build
